description: When a new item enters the queue, run the three crew roles (Triage, Researcher, Critic) and require all three blocks before the item becomes visible.
name: triage-on-ingest
note: Slice 3: this hook now runs as code, not config. appendLive in app/page.js passes every ingested batch through applyTriageHook (lib/crew.js), which rejects items failing validateItem (missing a crew block) and reports the rejected count in the UI instead of silently dropping records. Live items start with the slice 2 keyword heuristic; when the server has DEV_STITCH_GEMINI_API_KEY configured, the model crew replaces the heuristic blocks via /api/crew (key server-side only, never bundled). With no key, heuristic + seeded demo keep working.
steps: Triage: assign class, priority P0-P3, score, reason
Critic: set verdict pass/flag with a note; flags must name the blocker
Reject the item (do not display) if any block is missing
